PROVENANCE NOTE (Tower of Babel staging): In Latin. Second tome of Knorr von Rosenroth's anthology (Frankfurt, 1684), continuing the Latin Kabbalistic corpus — commentaries, the Siphra de Zeniutha with Luria's commentary, and related treatises. No public-domain English translation exists; Latin original staged per the library's non-English precedent. Source: Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_hG5BAAAAcAAJ). This 1684 Latin original (Frankfurt, 1684) is in the public domain in the United States.
